title: 2人分镜
description: 双人角色分镜生成：输入两个人物参考图和场景图，生成双人互动分镜

fields.name: 人物A
fields.description: 人物A的四视图或正面照，用于保持人物A一致性

fields.name: 人物B
fields.description: 人物B的四视图或正面照，用于保持人物B一致性

fields.name: 场景参考
fields.description: 场景/背景参考图，用于裁切构图区域

fields.name: 正向提示词
fields.description: 描述双人分镜画面：人物位置、动作、场景、构图
fields.default: masterpiece, best quality, ultra realistic photo, warm home living room, on the left side is the adult woman, on the right side is the 7-year-old boy, sitting side by side on soft sofa, mother and child reading story book together...

fields.name: 负向提示词
fields.description: 描述不希望出现的元素（模糊、变形等）
fields.default: blurry, low resolution, deformed face, distorted limbs, extra fingers, messy facial features, ugly, noisy, overexposed, fuzzy edges, mismatched skin texture, disfigured, cartoon, painting, 3d render
